notes.title: CYCLE DEMO PATCH NOTES - v1.24
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Disabled the debug mode for Clerestory, which could have been activated by accident before.
[*]Fixed the glitch that will let you go through walls while holding a direction/dashing into one while pausing and un-pausing.
[*]Fixed an NPC's name and pronouns showing incorrectly.
[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b] If any of you tackled a crash that occurs after fighting clerestory that seems to happen at a random interval after the battle, please let me know! I am looking into it and would love more information about it.

As always, if you have a bug to report, please do it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1947160/discussions/0/6006138415304576383/?snr=2_9_100000_]here![/url]

notes.title: CYCLE DEMO PATCH NOTES - v1.23
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a rendering error that occurs in the pause menu on fullscreen/non native resolutions.
[*]The controls selection in the options menu now scroll to the end if up is pressed on the first option.
[*]You can now quit both the controls menu and assist menu in the options menu by pressing the ESC key.
[*]Added benches to the top route of the Temple of Loathing.
[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b] If any of you tackled a crash that occurs after fighting clerestory that seems to happen at a random interval after the battle, please let me know! I am looking into it and would love more information about it.

As always, if you have a bug to report, please do it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1947160/discussions/0/6006138415304576383/?snr=2_9_100000_]here![/url]

notes.title: CYCLE DEMO PATCH NOTES - v1.22
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Wall jumping has been updated: it will now automatically pull you back towards the wall as long as you are not holding the opposite direction of the wall!
[*]Jumping next to a wall while on the ground now doesn't make you jump backwards.
[/list]

As always, if you have a bug to report, please do it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1947160/discussions/0/6006138415304576383/?snr=2_9_100000_]here![/url]

notes.title: CYCLE DEMO PATCH NOTES - v1.21
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to go back from the next to last room in the middle path of the Temple of Loathing.
[*]The map now places you correctly in the last room of the middle path of Temple of Loathing.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would crash unexpectably after defeating the Wyrm boss in Galaxy Mall.
[/list]
You can submit bug reports to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1947160/discussions/0/6006138415304576383/]this thread![/url]
